name: Air Products
description: Air Products makes oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen and helium and sells them to refiners, chemical makers, electronics fabs, steel and food companies. In FY2025, 52% of sales came from on-site plants built next to a customer under long contracts, 44% from merchant liquid and packaged gas, and 4% from selling cryogenic equipment. Its recent strategy put a large share of capital into clean-hydrogen and ammonia projects (NEOM in Saudi Arabia, Louisiana, others), and those have gone badly: FY2025 had an operating loss of $877M because of about $3.0B of after-tax project-exit charges, and in June 2026 it cancelled the Louisiana clean-energy complex with a further $2.9B pre-tax charge.

hq.note: FY2025 10-K cover: 1940 Air Products Boulevard, Allentown, PA 18106 (Wikipedia list shows Upper Macungie Township, PA, the same site)

employees.note: approximately; over 99% full time, about 75% outside the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: On-site and pipeline gas sold under long take-or-pay contracts to refiners and chemical plants, plus merchant bulk and cylinder gas priced per unit.
businessLines.description: Industrial gases in the US, Canada and Latin America, including its large Gulf Coast hydrogen pipeline network.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income (before $877M consolidated operating loss from business and asset action charges not in segments); shares are of total segment operating income $2,857.7M

businessLines.name: Asia
businessLines.how: On-site gas supply contracts to electronics, chemical and steel customers, plus merchant gas.
businessLines.description: Industrial gases in China, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia and Japan region.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income (before $877M consolidated operating loss from business and asset action charges not in segments); shares are of total segment operating income $2,857.7M

businessLines.name: Europe
businessLines.how: Mostly merchant liquid and packaged gas sold per unit; smaller on-site base.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income (before $877M consolidated operating loss from business and asset action charges not in segments); shares are of total segment operating income $2,857.7M

businessLines.name: Middle East and India
businessLines.how: Sales are small because most operations are equity affiliates; profit comes mainly as equity income ($340.9M in FY2025) from joint ventures in Saudi Arabia and elsewhere.
businessLines.description: Industrial gases in the Middle East and India, mostly through equity-method joint ventures; also holds the NEOM green hydrogen project.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income (before $877M consolidated operating loss from business and asset action charges not in segments); shares are of total segment operating income $2,857.7M

businessLines.name: Corporate and other
businessLines.how: One-time equipment sales recognised on project progress; corporate costs run through this line.
businessLines.description: Equipment sales (cryogenic and gas-processing, air separation units), Rotoflow turboexpanders and Gardner Cryogenics, plus corporate costs. LNG process technology business sold to Honeywell on 2024-09-30.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating income (before $877M consolidated operating loss from business and asset action charges not in segments); shares are of total segment operating income $2,857.7M

brands.name: NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC)
brands.share: Variable interest entity consolidated by Air Products in Middle East and India; Air Products is exclusive offtaker of green ammonia under a take-if-tendered agreement
brands.note: Green ammonia plant in NEOM, Saudi Arabia; Air Products expects onstream in 2027

whatsNext.text: NEOM Green Hydrogen Project expected onstream and delivering green ammonia
